name: Creative asset engine CLI
purpose: Provider-independent asset acquisition: capability planning, asynchronous jobs with bounded retries, timeouts, resume without re-submitting, fallback chains, secret redaction, a content-addressed asset library with provenance, reuse by request hash and export into a project.
capabilities: providers, plan, procedural, import, generate, jobs, resume, list, show, approve, reject, export
procedural recipes: paper-grain, halftone, gradient-field, torn-paper, depth-haze, silhouette-layer, caustics
kie adapter with documented partial verification; no MuAPI adapter

compatibility.notes: Default workflow needs no credential. Library under assets/library/ (index and jobs tracked, media ignored).

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Credentials from environment variables only; redacted from every record. Network only when a remote provider is used.

approval_evidence: Exercised in tests/test-creative-intelligence.py (54 tests) and on three demonstration projects on the M2 host (2026-11-02). Experimental: not promoted to approved because that requires a render-host evidence trail over more than one session.
